page.notes: The running head is a decorative heavy bar at the top centre; its words could not be read. "sciēti" is read from a superscript mark over the e and may be "scienti": the mark is faint. The "ce-la-" at the foot is a word split across the line end with printed hyphens, so the word continues on the next page. Spelling "prestare" and "prestari" is printed with the ligature st and an ę, transcribed as pręstare and pręstari. "Ius" with a capital in mid-sentence is as printed.
